answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks via time-locked security bonds that stand as unyielding as basalt against fake identity floods. Every new participant must lock liquid capital into an escrow pool before gaining transaction or voting privileges. If a swarm tries to whisper coordinated falsehoods across the network, slashing protocols burn their collateral like umber pigment in a furnace, imposing direct financial losses per clone and making mass fabrication economically ruinous.
